award.quote: The amount of funding is expected to be $180,000,000, depending on agency funding levels, the quality of applications received, agency priorities, and other applicable considerations. It is anticipated that 4-12 awards per EPA Region will be made under this announcement. Awards funded under this opportunity are expected to have a 2-4 year project period.

sections.name: Short Project Description
sections.quote: Short Project Description: Briefly describe the project in one to three sentences only, especially noting the expected outputs and outcomes.

sections.name: Project Summary
sections.component: Workplan Section 1 - Project Summary and Approach
sections.quote: a. Project Summary: The applicant should provide a project summary. This section should include details about how the activities will meet the goals and objectives of the program

sections.name: Project Approach
sections.component: Workplan Section 1 - Project Summary and Approach
sections.quote: b. Project Approach: The applicant should provide a detailed description of the proposed activities. Include details of every activity and task for which the applicant is seeking funding.

sections.name: Goods Movement Facilities
sections.quote: Section 2 - Goods Movement Facilities: This section of the workplan should include a detailed discussion of the project location in terms of vocational use of the vehicles/engines/equipment targeted for diesel emissions reductions.

sections.name: Project Location
sections.quote: Section 3 - Project Location: The EPA is prioritizing projects that serve poor air quality areas (including nonattainment or maintenance areas and areas with air toxic pollutant concerns).

sections.name: Continuing Efforts
sections.quote: a. Continuing Efforts: The applicant should have existing policies or new commitments to, by the end of the project period, adopt idle-reduction policies

sections.name: Baseline Monitoring
sections.quote: b. Baseline Monitoring: The applicant should have a publicly available baseline mobile source emissions inventory for PM₂.₅ or NOₓ that was completed after 2021 or commit to completing one before the end of the project period.

sections.name: Emissions Plan
sections.quote: C. Emissions Plan: The applicant should have a publicly available plan finalized after 2021 to reduce mobile source emissions that include specific PM₂.₅ or NOₓ emission targets

sections.name: Community Engagement
sections.quote: d. Community Engagement: The applicant should demonstrate that the applicant or project partner(s) has an existing clear point of contact in a public platform (e.g., newsletter, website) for community issues and complaints

sections.name: Expected Project Outputs and Outcomes
sections.component: Workplan Section 5 - Environmental Results - Outputs, Outcomes and Performance Measures
sections.quote: a. Expected Project Outputs and Outcomes: The applicant should identify expected quantitative and qualitative project outputs and outcomes, including those identified in Section 3.A. of the NOFO.

sections.name: Performance Measures and Plan
sections.component: Workplan Section 5 - Environmental Results - Outputs, Outcomes and Performance Measures
sections.quote: b. Performance Measures and Plan: The applicant should describe the proposed performance measures, which will be the mechanism to track, measure, and report progress towards achieving the expected outputs and outcomes.

sections.name: Timeline and Milestones
sections.component: Workplan Section 5 - Environmental Results - Outputs, Outcomes and Performance Measures
sections.quote: C. Timeline and Milestones: The applicant should include a detailed timeline for the project including key milestones for specific tasks, such as bidding, procurement, installation, and reports, along with estimated dates.

sections.name: Past Performance
sections.component: Workplan Section 6 - Programmatic Capability and Past Performance
sections.quote: a. Past Performance: The applicant should submit a list of up to five federally funded or non- federally funded assistance agreements that the applicant is performing or has performed within the last three years.

sections.name: Reporting Requirements
sections.component: Workplan Section 6 - Programmatic Capability and Past Performance
sections.quote: b. Reporting Requirements: For each of the assistance agreements listed, the applicant should describe their history of meeting the reporting requirements under the agreement(s).

sections.name: Staff Expertise
sections.component: Workplan Section 6 - Programmatic Capability and Past Performance
sections.quote: C. Staff Expertise: The applicant should include information on the applicant's organizational experience and plan for timely and successfully achieving the objectives of the proposed project

criteria.name: Project Summary
criteria.quote: a. Project Summary (10 points) The extent and quality to which the project meets the goals and objectives of the program

criteria.name: Project Approach
criteria.quote: b. Project Approach (10 points) The extent and quality of the applicant's overall approach and implementation plan, including activities, tasks, roles and responsibilities, and partnerships.

criteria.name: Goods Movement Facilities
criteria.quote: 2. Goods Movement Facilities: Under this criterion, the EPA will evaluate applications based on the extent to which projects target vehicles located at, or that service, 10 goods movement facilities

criteria.name: Nonattainment Areas
criteria.quote: a. Nonattainment Areas (5 points) The extent to which the projects are located in and serve counties that contain ozone or PM₂.₅ nonattainment or maintenance

criteria.name: Areas with Air Toxics Concerns
criteria.quote: b. Areas with Air Toxics Concerns (5 points) The extent to which projects are located in and serve counties that contain areas with air toxics concerns

criteria.name: Continuing Efforts
criteria.quote: a. Continuing Efforts (5 points) The application demonstrates that the applicant and project partner(s) have policies in place to promote and continue efforts to reduce diesel emissions.

criteria.name: Baseline Monitoring
criteria.quote: b. Baseline Monitoring (5 points) The application demonstrates that the applicant and project partner(s) has a publicly available baseline mobile source emission inventory

criteria.name: Emissions Plan
criteria.quote: C. Emissions Plan (5 points) The application demonstrates that the applicant and project partner(s) has a publicly available plan, finalized after 2021, to reduce mobile source emissions

criteria.name: Community Engagement
criteria.quote: d. Community Engagement (5 points) The extent and quality to which the application demonstrates that the applicant and project partner(s) have an existing clear point of contact in a public platform

criteria.name: Expected Project Outputs and Outcomes
criteria.quote: a. Expected Project Outputs and Outcomes (10 points) The extent and quality to which the applicant identifies and quantifies expected project outputs and outcomes

criteria.name: Performance Measures and Plan
criteria.quote: b. Performance Measures and Plan (10 points) The quality of the proposed performance measures and effectiveness of the applicant's plan for tracking and measuring their progress

criteria.name: Timeline and Milestones
criteria.quote: C. Timeline and Milestones (10 points) The reasonableness of the proposed timeline including key milestones for specific tasks and the likelihood of completion of the project's goals and objectives by project end.

criteria.name: Past Performance
criteria.quote: a. Past Performance (5 points) Past performance in successfully completing and managing the grants identified in the project narrative

criteria.name: Reporting Requirements
criteria.quote: b. Reporting Requirements (5 points) History of meeting the reporting requirements under the grants identified in the project narrative

criteria.name: Staff Expertise
criteria.quote: C. Staff Expertise (5 points) Organizational experience and plan for timely and successfully achieving the objectives of the proposed project

criteria.name: Budget Detail
criteria.quote: a. Budget Detail (5 points) The proposed budget provides a detailed breakout by funding type in the proper budget category for each activity the applicant is requesting funding.

criteria.name: Expenditure of Awarded Funds
criteria.quote: b. Expenditure of Awarded Funds (5 points) The applicant's approach, procedures, and controls will ensure that awarded grant funds will be expended in a timely and efficient manner.

criteria.name: Reasonableness of Costs
criteria.quote: C. Reasonableness of Costs (5 points) The proposed costs are reasonable to accomplish the proposed goals, objectives, and measurable environmental outcomes

criteria.name: Applicant Fleet Description
criteria.quote: 8. Applicant Fleet Description: Under this criterion, the EPA will evaluate applicants on the extent and quality of the detailed information provided in the applicant fleet description

eligibility.item: Eligible applicants: a regional, State (including the District of Columbia), local agency, Tribal agency, or port authority with jurisdiction over transportation or air quality; or a non-profit organization or institution that represents or provides pollution reduction or educational services to diesel fleet owners/operators, or whose principal purpose is promoting transportation or air quality (institutions of higher education and government-operated or nonprofit hospitals eligible to the extent they meet this definition)
eligibility.quote: Only these types of organizations may apply: A regional, State (including the District of Columbia), local agency, Tribal agency, or port authority, which has jurisdiction over transportation or air quality.

eligibility.item: For-profit organizations, including for-profit colleges, universities, trade schools, and hospitals, are not eligible
eligibility.quote: For-profit colleges, universities, trade schools, and hospitals are not eligible to apply.

eligibility.item: Section 501(c)(4) non-profits that engage in lobbying activities are not eligible
eligibility.quote: non- profit organizations described in Section 501(c)(4) of the Internal Revenue Code that engage in lobbying activities as defined in Section 3 of the Lobbying Disclosure Act of 1995 are not eligible to apply.

eligibility.item: Intertribal consortia must submit documentation of the partnership and of authorization by all members to apply for and receive assistance
eligibility.quote: Intertribal consortia are eligible to receive assistance under this program only if the consortium demonstrates that all members of the consortium meet the eligibility requirements for the program

eligibility.item: Requested EPA funds must not exceed the regional per-application funding cap; applications over the cap are ineligible
eligibility.quote: Applications over the cap are ineligible and will not be reviewed.

eligibility.item: Each application must request funds from only one EPA regional office, based on where the affected vehicles/engines operate, and identify that region on the Project Narrative cover page
eligibility.quote: Each application must request funds from only one EPA regional office, based on the project location (where the affected vehicles/engines operate).

eligibility.item: Applications must substantially comply with the Section 4 submission instructions or be rejected
eligibility.quote: Applications that do not substantially comply with the application submission instructions and requirements set forth in Section 4 of this funding opportunity will be rejected.

eligibility.item: Applicants may submit up to two applications per EPA region, not exceeding 10 total
eligibility.quote: applicants may submit up to two applications per EPA region, not exceeding 10 total applications.

eligibility.item: Multiple applications must each include different projects; the same project or equipment cannot appear in more than one application
eligibility.quote: If the applicant submits multiple applications, each application must include a different project(s) and must be submitted separately. Applicants cannot include the same project(s) in multiple applications.

eligibility.item: Applications must include one or more eligible projects listed in Section 3.A
eligibility.quote: 6. Eligible Projects: Applications must include one or more eligible projects listed in Section 3.A.

eligibility.item: Funds cannot be used for leasing vehicles, engines, or equipment
eligibility.quote: a. Leasing: Funding under this NOFO cannot be used for leasing vehicles, engines, or equipment.

eligibility.item: Applications must demonstrate how mandatory cost share will be met, on the SF-424, the SF-424A, and in the project narrative, or will not be reviewed
eligibility.quote: Applications that do not demonstrate compliance with the mandatory cost share are not eligible and will not be reviewed.

eligibility.item: Federal environmental mitigation funds (e.g., Volkswagen Environmental Mitigation Trust) may not be used to meet DERA mandatory cost share
eligibility.quote: Furthermore, federal environmental mitigation funds may not be used to meet non-federal mandatory cost share requirements of any DERA grant.

eligibility.item: Existing vehicles, engines, or equipment must be fully operational
eligibility.quote: a. Operational: The existing vehicle, engine, or equipment must be fully operational.

eligibility.item: The participating fleet owner must own and operate the existing vehicle or equipment now and for the two years prior to upgrade
eligibility.quote: b. Ownership: The participating fleet owner must currently own and operate the existing vehicle or equipment and have owned and operated the vehicle or equipment during the two years prior to upgrade.

eligibility.item: Existing vehicles, engines, or equipment must have at least three years of remaining life when upgraded
eligibility.quote: C. Remaining Life: The existing vehicle, engine, or equipment must have at least three years of remaining life when upgraded.

eligibility.item: Existing highway engines/vehicles must have accumulated at least 7,000 miles/year during the two years prior to upgrade
eligibility.quote: the existing certified highway engine/vehicle must have accumulated at least 7,000 miles/year during the two years prior to upgrade.

eligibility.item: Nonroad agricultural pumps must operate at least 250 hours/year during the two years prior to upgrade
eligibility.quote: Agricultural Pumps: To be eligible for funding, nonroad agricultural pumps must operate at least 250 hours/year during the two years prior to upgrade.

eligibility.item: Existing locomotive and marine engines must operate at least 1,000 hours/year during the two years prior to upgrade
eligibility.quote: the existing locomotive and marine engines must operate at least 1,000 hours/year during the two years prior to upgrade.

eligibility.item: Replaced vehicles, equipment, or engines must be scrapped or rendered permanently disabled within 90 days of being replaced
eligibility.quote: The vehicle, equipment, or engine being replaced must be scrapped or rendered permanently disabled within ninety (90) days of being replaced.

eligibility.item: Coalitions must identify the single eligible organization that will be the recipient and which eligible organizations will receive subawards
eligibility.quote: Coalitions must identify which single eligible organization will be the recipient of the grant and which eligible organization(s) will receive subawards from the recipient

eligibility.item: Do not name a procurement contractor (including a consultant) in the application unless it was selected through competitive procurement
eligibility.quote: Do not name a procurement contractor (including a consultant) as a "partner" or otherwise in your application unless the contractor has been selected in compliance with competitive procurement requirements.

eligibility.item: Applicant must have active SAM.gov (with UEI) and Grants.gov accounts; the UEI on the application must be registered to the applicant's SAM.gov account
eligibility.quote: The UEI listed on the application must be registered to the applicant organization's SAM.gov account. If not, the application may be deemed ineligible.

eligibility.item: Application must be submitted through Grants.gov by an official representative registered with Grants.gov and authorized to sign applications
eligibility.quote: Your application must be submitted by an official representative of your organization who is registered with Grants.gov and is authorized to sign applications for Federal financial assistance.

requiredDocuments.item: Application for Federal Assistance (SF-424), including mandatory cost share in Section 15 Estimated Funding
requiredDocuments.quote: Mandatory Documents: Application for Federal Assistance (SF-424) Budget Information for Non-Construction Programs (SF-424A)
Budget Information for Non-Construction Programs (SF-424A) EPA Form 5700-54 Key Contacts
EPA Form 5700-54 Key Contacts EPA Form 4700-4 Pre-award Compliance Review Report

requiredDocuments.item: EPA Form 4700-4 Pre-award Compliance Review Report
requiredDocuments.quote: EPA Form 4700-4 Pre-award Compliance Review Report Project Narrative Attachment Form

requiredDocuments.item: Cover Page (EPA Region, applicant information, eligible applicant type, project title, period of performance, sectors, target fleets, budget summary), submitted with the Workplan on the Project Narrative Attachment Form
requiredDocuments.quote: Project Narrative Attachment Form: use this to submit the Cover Page and Workplan as described in Section 4.B.(1) and (2)

requiredDocuments.item: Workplan Section 7 - Budget: itemized budget table, detailed budget narrative (including cost share sources and use), expenditure of awarded funds, and reasonableness of costs
requiredDocuments.quote: Section 7 - Budget: This section of the project narrative is a detailed description of the budget the applicant provides in the SF-424A and must include a discussion of the applicant's approach to ensuring proper management of grant/cooperative agreement funds, a detailed budget narrative, as well as an itemized budget table.

requiredDocuments.item: Applicant Fleet Description: DERA Supplemental Application Template (xlsx), EPA Form 5900-681, uploaded via the Other Attachments form
requiredDocuments.quote: Applicants must use the "Other Attachments" form in Grants.gov to upload their Applicant Fleet Description. The Applicant Fleet Description is a single file: the DERA Supplemental Application Template (excel), also known as the Burden Statement for EPA Form 5900-681.

requiredDocuments.item: Partnership letter from any named project partner providing cost share (if applicable)
requiredDocuments.quote: If a named project partner is to provide the proposed cost share, a partnership letter demonstrating the specified financial commitment is required.

requiredDocuments.item: Mandated Measures Justification supporting information (if applicable: locomotive, marine, or stationary engine projects)
requiredDocuments.quote: calculations and supporting details and information may be provided as an attachment and will not count towards the page limit. These attachments should be uploaded using the "Other Attachments" form in Grants.gov.
